university.name: University of Brighton
university.summary: The University of Brighton is in Brighton, which its international pages place about one hour from central London. It teaches undergraduate and taught postgraduate courses and publishes tuition fee reductions that are applied automatically to eligible international students.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time, or 4 years with an optional placement year
courses.overview: A full-time computing degree at the Moulsecoomb campus covering programming, cyber security, web development and artificial intelligence, with an optional placement year.
courses.academic_requirements: 2027 entry: A levels ABB to BCC; BTEC Extended Diploma DDM to MMM; International Baccalaureate 27 points with three Higher level subjects; UCAS tariff 104 to 128 points.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in each element.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Brighton's Pakistan page states: associate degree (four semesters) with 60% overall, or a bachelor's degree of at least two years with 60% overall, for Year 1 entry; applicants with a Higher Secondary School Certificate (Standard XII) must complete an international foundation year or equivalent. The same page states Brighton will not accept a Pakistani English language qualification as meeting its English requirement.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists graduate roles in AI and machine learning, cyber security, software engineering, data analytics, games development and UX design.
courses.notes: Page shows 2027 entry requirements but no start month. Fee shown is the 2026/27 international fee; target year fee not yet published. Page does not say which Year 1 modules are optional.

courses.title: International Business Management
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time, or 4 years with a placement year or year abroad
courses.overview: A full-time business degree at the Moulsecoomb campus with an international focus, offering a placement year or a year abroad with partner institutions after Year 2.
courses.academic_requirements: 2027 entry: A levels ABB to BCC; BTEC Extended Diploma DDM to MMM; International Baccalaureate 27 points with three Higher level subjects; UCAS tariff 104 to 128 points.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in each element.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Brighton's Pakistan page states: associate degree (four semesters) with 60% overall, or a bachelor's degree of at least two years with 60% overall, for Year 1 entry; applicants with a Higher Secondary School Certificate (Standard XII) must complete an international foundation year or equivalent. The same page states Brighton will not accept a Pakistani English language qualification as meeting its English requirement.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists example graduate roles including business development manager, international sales manager and global business analyst.
courses.notes: Page shows 2027 entry requirements but no start month. Fee shown is the 2026/27 international fee; target year fee not yet published. Page does not say which Year 1 modules are optional. Placement year fee for 2026/27 starters is GBP 1,958.

courses.title: Management
courses.duration_text: 1 year full-time, or 2 years with a placement; part-time 2 to 3 years
courses.overview: A taught master's in Brighton Business School at the Moulsecoomb campus, with specialisms in entrepreneurship, human resource management or international management chosen at the end of term two.
highlights: Core: Global Supply Chain and Finance
courses.academic_requirements: Normally a 2:2 honours degree. A degree in any subject is considered.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each element.
courses.experience_requirements: Work experience is useful but not essential.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Brighton's Pakistan page states: four-year bachelor's degree with GPA 2.5 to 2.8 or 55 to 60%; or a master's degree following a three-year bachelor's with GPA 2.5 to 2.8 or 55 to 60%. The same page states Brighton will not accept a Pakistani English language qualification as meeting its English requirement.
courses.career_notes: The course page says the programme prepares graduates for careers in international management, consultancy, HR, marketing and operations.
courses.notes: Page says September and January starts and names September 2026 or January 2027 as the open intakes; a September 2027 start is not shown. Fee is the 2026/27 first year international fee; target year fee not yet published. Pakistan percentage is a range on the country page and is not course specific, so pk_min_percent is left null.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 1 year full-time, or 2 years with a placement year; part-time 2 to 6 years
courses.overview: A taught master's at the Moulsecoomb campus open to graduates of any subject, covering programming, applied artificial intelligence and cyber threat intelligence, with a major project.
highlights: Cyber Threat Intelligence and Security Operations
courses.academic_requirements: Normally a good honours degree in any subject. Applicants without a degree but with relevant industrial experience usually attend an interview.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in each element.
courses.experience_requirements: Relevant industrial experience considered in place of a degree; no minimum length shown.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Brighton's Pakistan page states: four-year bachelor's degree with GPA 2.5 to 2.8 or 55 to 60%; or a master's degree following a three-year bachelor's with GPA 2.5 to 2.8 or 55 to 60%. The same page states Brighton will not accept a Pakistani English language qualification as meeting its English requirement.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists destinations including cyber security analyst, AI developer, software engineer and business analyst.
courses.notes: Required degree class not shown (only 'good honours degree'). Page names September 2026 or January 2027 as open intakes; a September 2027 start is not shown. Fee is the 2026/27 first year international fee; target year fee not yet published. Page does not say which modules are core or optional.

scholarships.name: Vice-Chancellor International Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 4,000 tuition fee reduction over a standard three-year course: GBP 2,000 in Year 1, then GBP 1,000 in each of Years 2 and 3
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction applied automatically to eligible self-funded international-fee students on full-time undergraduate courses who are new to the university.
scholarships.criteria_text: Holds an offer for a full-time course; international fee status; self-funded with no external sponsor; new student who has not studied at Brighton before. Not available for MPharm or Brighton and Sussex Medical School applicants.
scholarships.deadline_note: No scholarship deadline stated; applicants must accept the offer, pay the deposit and apply for a CAS by the deadline.
scholarships.notes: Page lists no countries, only international fee status. Page states scholarships cannot be deferred to a later intake. Advanced entry and top-up students receive different amounts, subject to confirmation.

scholarships.name: Vice-Chancellor International Postgraduate Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,000 reduction on tuition fees, first year of study only
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction applied automatically to eligible self-funded international-fee students on full-time taught postgraduate courses who are new to the university.
scholarships.criteria_text: Holds an offer for a full-time course; international fee status; self-funded with no external sponsor (loans allowed); new student who has not studied at Brighton before. Excludes PGCert, PGCE, PGDip, MPharm, MRes, MPhil, PhD and medical school applicants.
scholarships.deadline_note: No application deadline stated; applied after the first tuition fee payment deadline (31 October for September 2026, 28 February for January 2027).
scholarships.intake_label: September 2026 or January 2027 (2027 terms not yet published)
scholarships.notes: Page lists no countries, only international fee status. Page states scholarships cannot be deferred to a later intake. Can be combined with listed awards for a stated total discount of GBP 3,500 to GBP 5,000.

scholarships.name: Deans' Global Talent Award (Postgraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 1,000 for the School of Business and Law or the School of Architecture, Technology and Engineering; GBP 500 for other schools
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction assessed automatically during admissions for self-funded international-fee students new to the university on taught postgraduate courses.
scholarships.criteria_text: Self-funded (loans allowed, external sponsorship not); new to Brighton; not a Brighton graduate, partner college student or UBIC pre-masters progressor. Excludes PGCert, PGCE, PGDip, MPharm, MRes, MPhil, PhD and medical school applicants.
scholarships.deadline_note: No application deadline stated; applied after the first tuition fee payment deadline (31 October for September 2026, 28 February for January 2027).
scholarships.intake_label: September 2026 or January 2027 (2027 terms not yet published)
scholarships.notes: Page does not explicitly say an offer is required, though its next steps begin with accepting an offer. Excludes certain MSc courses covered by the Future STEM Scholars' Awards.

scholarships.name: Future STEM Scholars' Award (Postgraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,500 tuition fee reduction, applied in the first year
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction for self-funded international-fee students holding an offer for one of five listed technology and engineering MSc courses.
scholarships.criteria_text: Offer for Advanced Manufacturing MSc, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning MSc, Artificial Intelligence and Robotics MSc, Building Information Management MSc or Cyber Security MSc; international fee status; self-funded; new to Brighton. Not for University of Brighton International College pre-masters progressors or Brighton graduates.
scholarships.deadline_note: No application deadline stated; applied after the first tuition payment deadline (31 October for September 2026, 28 February for January 2027).
scholarships.intake_label: September 2026 or January 2027 (2027 terms not yet published)
scholarships.notes: Applies only to the five listed courses. Can be combined with the GBP 2,000 Vice-Chancellor scholarship and a GBP 500 early-bird discount for up to GBP 5,000 in total, as stated on the page.
